title.narrative: Providing shelter assistance to flood victims and returnees from Pakistan to Afghanistan for the year 2024

description.narrative: Approximately (30,100) beneficiaries received shelter assistance, which contributes to alleviating their suffering.
Providing support to families affected by the floods that hit the Republic of Afghanistan and those returning from Pakistan to Afghanistan by distributing tents and shelter bags

Securing (4,300) shelter bags and distributing them to those affected by the floods and those returning from Pakistan to Afghanistan in the regions of (Kabul, Kapisa, Panjshir, Baghlan, Kunduz, Badakhshan, Ghazni, Herat, Nimruz, Bamyan, Nangarhar, Laghman, Parwan)
